title: -ing clauses (He hurt his knee playing football.)

exercises.instruction: Choose from Box A and Box B to make sentences. Use -ing.

parts: Amy was sitting in an armchair

answers: trying not to make a noise
saying she would be back in an hour

parts: Lisa worked in Rome for two years

answers: looking at the sights and taking pictures

exercises.instruction: Put the words in the right order.

answers: Joe hurt his knee playing football.

items.prompt: I (in the rain / wet / got / very / walking)
answers: I got very wet walking in the rain.

items.prompt: Laura (to work / had / driving / an accident)
answers: Laura had an accident driving to work.

items.prompt: My friend (off / slipped / a bus / getting / and fell)
answers: My friend slipped and fell getting off a bus.

items.prompt: Emily (trying / her back / a heavy box / to lift / hurt)
answers: Emily hurt her back trying to lift a heavy box.

items.prompt: Two people were (to put out / by smoke / the fire / overcome / trying)
answers: Two people were overcome by smoke trying to put out the fire.

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences. Use Having + a suitable verb.

items.prompt: Having finished her work, Katherine left the office and went home.
modelAnswers: Having finished her work, Katherine left the office and went home.

items.prompt: _____ our tickets, we went into the theatre and took our seats.
_____ the problem, I think we’ll be able to find a solution.
_____ he was hungry, Joe now says he doesn’t want to eat anything.
_____ his job recently, James is now unemployed.
modelAnswers: Having been fired from his job

items.prompt: _____ most of his life in London, Sam has now gone to live in a small village in the country.
modelAnswers: Having spent most of his life
Having lived (for) most of his life

exercises.instruction: Make one sentence from two. Begin with -ing or Not -ing. Sometimes you need to begin with Having …. Don’t forget the comma (,).

items.prompt: I felt tired. So I went to bed early.
answers: Feeling tired, I went to bed early.

items.prompt: I thought they might be hungry. So I offered them something to eat.
answers: Thinking they might be hungry, I offered them something to eat.

items.prompt: Robert is a vegetarian. So he doesn’t eat any kind of meat.
answers: Being a vegetarian, Robert doesn’t eat any kind of meat.

items.prompt: I didn’t have a phone. So I had no way of contacting anyone.
answers: Not having a phone, I had no way of contacting anyone.

items.prompt: Sarah has travelled a lot. So she knows a lot about other countries.
answers: Having travelled a lot, Sarah knows a lot about other countries.

items.prompt: I wasn’t able to speak the local language. So I had trouble communicating.
answers: Not being able to speak the local language, I had trouble communicating.

items.prompt: We had spent nearly all our money. So we couldn’t afford to stay at a hotel.
answers: Having spent nearly all our money, we couldn’t afford to stay at a hotel.
